title: Designing Algorithmic Features for Online Dating
description: We conducted interviews and user-participatory design workshops where online daters share their online dating experiences, and design the algorithmic features shich can mitigate the challenges of the UX with online dating algorithms.

title: How do Koreans convey emotions through ㅋ, ㅎㅎ, ㅠㅠㅠㅠ?
description: We used a mixed method approach and collected data from 86 survey participants and 10 interview participants to understand subtle emotional differences in Korean contributing to computer-mediated-communication.

title: Paprika: A diet management app using colors to control appetite
description: Paprika is an application design project using existing technology and qualitative research methods: We designed a nutrition application supporting patients through recoloring food contents based on the correlation of appetite and food color.

title: Pain is healed by revealing: Alley regeneration of the Red District Wanwol-dong
description: We suggested an urban regeneration plan of 5 years to redevelop 'Wanwol-dong' which is the largest and oldest red-district remaining in Busan, Korea.

title: Office Hotel: Designing a Hotel for Bleisure Visitors in Gwanghwamun
description: This is an architecture project to renovate an existing hotel placed in the heart of Gwanghwamun, to target office workers visiting Gwanghwamun alone for a short period of time.
